name: supply_chain_write_inventory_planning_parameters
description:
Write item-level inventory planning parameters to NeonPanel (PUT /api/v1/companies/{uuid}/inventory-items/{inventory_id}). Consequential write tool.

Use this when the user wants to save planning parameters for specific inventory items. Each write updates one inventory item's restock_data. Pass only fields that should change; omitted restock_data fields are left unchanged by the API.

Important hierarchy:
- Item-level values saved here override company-level defaults for that inventory item.
- For company-wide defaults, use supply_chain_write_company_planning_defaults.

Safety:
- dry_run defaults to true and returns the API operations that would be executed.
- Set dry_run=false only after confirming the intended changes.
- Prefer inventory_get_details first when current restock_data values matter.

Fields include lead_time_days, safety_stock_days, fba_lead_time_days, fba_safety_stock_days, unit_vendor_price, unit_landed_cost, target_price, target_fba_fee, target_referral_percentage, daily_sales_target, daily_unit_sales_target, estimated_daily_sales, estimated_price.

company_id.description: Numeric company ID. Preferred when available.

companyUuid.description: Company UUID. Use company_id when available.

dry_run.description: If true, validate and preview API writes without persisting. Defaults to true.

restock_data.description: Planning parameters to write for this inventory item. At least one field is required.
